about: Written by e2er at export (2026-10-15) from what the run recorded: the scripts that wrote estimation_results.json, from the estimation script on, in the order the run ran them (its script log); the files they read; and the packages they import. code/requirements.txt pins 2 package(s) at the versions the run used.

steps.about: load the inputs the folder does not ship (if any)
data preparation: builds the study's tables from the loaded ones

inputs.source: the study's database, tables: country_names (Natural Earth vector data: Admin 0 – Countries, countries of the world, Natural Earth v5.1.2, 1:50 million, EPSG:4326, release v5.1.2, loaded 2026-10-13); road_deaths_2021 (Global Health Observatory (GHO) data repository, World Health Organization, WHO GHO RS_198: Estimated road traffic death rate (per 100 000 population) (all locations, 2021–2021), release 2024-04-15, loaded 2026-10-13); who_region_lookup (made by the study during the run); who_rs198_2021 (Global Health Observatory (GHO) data repository, World Health Organization, WHO GHO RS_198: Estimated road traffic death rate (per 100 000 population) (all locations, 2021–2021), release 2024-04-15, loaded 2026-10-13); who_rs198_2021_clean (made by the study during the run)

notes: When data.db is not in the folder, clean_rs198.py builds the tables the estimation reads (who_region_lookup, who_rs198_2021_clean) again from the tables get_data.py loads, as the run did.

The WHO Global Health Observatory's terms allow use for public health purposes only, and no changes without WHO's written permission, so a published study may leave its data out. get_data.py loads these data again with e2er-data when the folder lacks them.
The run recorded no Python version for its scripts (e2er up to 0.16.0), so the recipe names the Python e2er exported the study with (3.12.12); the study may have run on another.
